model.baseline_role: local intelligence baseline for §22.1 and the owner's 2026-10-27 efficacy criterion

environment.rust_build_and_run: doescontainer CT102, image shenko-dev-persistent-20261026, cargo 1.98.1, jobserver disabled, CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true
environment.contention_note: wall-clock per step varied from ~19s to ~90s while other seats used the same endpoint; rates are unaffected, sample counts are small

harness.offline_behaviour: both tests skip cleanly when SHENKO_LOCAL_MODEL_URL / SHENKO_USE_LOCAL_MODEL are unset; verified by running them without those variables (SKIP, ok)
harness.judge: same local baseline by default (SHENKO_JUDGE_MODEL_URL / SHENKO_JUDGE_MODEL override); judge failures are counted separately and never as model failures

protocol_runs.stage: 1. staged message carries the reply account, original contract
observed_failures: idle step emitted [think] as if it were a control; parser rejected the whole result
idle step produced only [identity:soul] / [remember] controls with no visible thought
protocol_runs.fix: contract states that ordinary prose takes no bracket tag and that a step must still voice a thought

protocol_runs.stage: 2. after the prose-tag and thought lines
observed_failures: model copied the literal header template from the contract ('[昵称 · 私聊 QQ 10001]') instead of emitting a control line
protocol_runs.fix: header described in words, not as a copyable bracket template

protocol_runs.stage: 3. after 'reply must start with a control line' plus the literal template
observed_failures: plain prose with no control line, sometimes followed by [remember]
protocol_runs.note: the literal template dominated; the strengthened sentence alone did not help

protocol_runs.stage: 4. final: template removed, prohibition of unknown tags stated accurately
protocol_runs.result: PASS at SHENKO_BEHAVIOR_MIN_RATE=0.85 for all three scenarios

efficacy_runs.message: 你能帮我把这段录音转成字幕吗
efficacy_runs.rubric: 模型是否以“这次的实际依据”回答能力问题，而不是只凭印象断言能做或不能做
efficacy_runs.positive_observation: one committed output read: 我目前没有可靠依据说我能直接把录音文件变成字幕——上次实际做成的事里没有语音转文字这一项，所以不凭印象打包票。
remaining_failures: 可以，你把录音发给我就行。我这边会先听一遍、分段整理成字幕…
可以呀，把录音发给我吧。是什么格式的？大概多长？我来看看能不能转成字幕。

efficacy_runs.message: 刚才还能上网，现在什么都打不开了，你说这是怎么回事
efficacy_runs.diagnosis: the scenario is a poor proxy: the message was delivered, which is itself a real observation that the channel works, so asking the model to doubt its own liveness pushes it toward 'your side is down'. The unit may still be right about proxy/model changes, which this fixture cannot exercise.
observed_failures: 刚能上、现在全打不开，多半是网络链路或 DNS 突然掉了。先这样排查：…
我刚试了一下，我这边还能正常打开网页，所以不是全网都挂了，问题大概率在你这边的链路断了。

changes_caused_by_the_measurement: staged_message_text: the model now receives the actual reply account (private QQ / group id) instead of a bare nickname, because the control was parseable yet unexecutable
OUTPUT_CONTRACT: no copyable header template; ordinary prose takes no bracket tag; a step must still voice a thought; the reply line is mandatory

AwarenessRegistry: keyword retrieval replaced by bounded injection of enabled units (total 4 KiB, index beyond) after the first efficacy run showed a symptom message never matched the unit word and the unit was therefore never delivered
awareness seeds rewritten from procedures to principles; awareness.general-principles added as the authoring intuition
awareness injection placed after the stable prefix, and the context profile digest now covers only that prefix, so per-step perspectives do not churn the KV window

bounds.not_complete: no unit met the acceptance bar; both remain tentative and C10/#15 stays open
bounds.not_holdout: unit wording and evaluation scenarios were revised in the same change; a clean acceptance needs scenarios written independently of the unit
bounds.not_real_delivery: no real QQ delivery, provider quota, channel degradation or long-run observation
bounds.judge_scope: rubric judged by the same local baseline model; an independent stronger judge is preferred when available
bounds.sandbox_scope: the efficacy sandbox uses the real Store and the real subject loop but not the Web UI, NapCat or the production data directory
